name: CaRS
description: Autonomous vehicles must excel in safety-critical perception tasks, especially in adverse weather conditions. In addition, transitional weather shifts in nature, such as sunny to rainy, rainy to cloudy, etc., pose abrupt illumination changes that can distort object boundaries and degrade segmentation performance. Existing research focuses mainly on segmentation in clear and discrete weather conditions, leaving a gap in addressing the issues of transitional weather scenarios.
